artists.biography:
Bullet Height is a British electronic-rock duo consisting of members Jon Courtney, formerly of progressive rock band 'Pure Reason Revolution' and Sammi Doll of dark electronica act 'IAMX'. The band is based in Berlin, Germany where the pair met on Halloween night through producer Tom Bellamy (Cooper Temple Clause, Losers) and began their recording sessions shortly after.

“I left London, moved to Berlin, rented a dirt-cheap room in an old DDR building & started battering out the music that would go on to become Bullet Height. I wanted to create something darker & heavier than ever before – I’d always written & produced in the past under no creative constraint & that has continued with this new band. From the first vocal session with Sammi I knew we were onto something" Jon Courtney comments.

The band was signed to Superball Music in January 2016 and they have released two singles - "Bastion" and "Hold Together" in preparation for their debut album release set for spring 2017.

perplexity.description:
No Atonement is the debut album by Berlin-based electronic-rock duo Bullet Height, released in May 2017 on Superball Music. The project brings together Sammi Doll of IAMX and Jon Courtney of Pure Reason Revolution, combining their respective backgrounds in industrial electronica and progressive rock. The album's ten tracks blend industrialized electronica, dark avant-garde textures, heavy guitars, and melodic elements into a cohesive sonic statement that reflects the band's collaborative vision.

The album's musical palette demonstrates a deliberate fusion of electronic and organic instrumentation, with standout tracks including "Bastion" and "Hold Together," both previously released as singles. The production approach emphasizes contrast—juxtaposing abrasive electronic elements with guitar-driven passages and introspective melodic moments. This stylistic diversity across tracks like "Fight Song," "Wild Worlds," and "Intravenous" establishes the band's willingness to explore different emotional and textural territories within a cohesive artistic framework.

As Bullet Height's inaugural full-length release, No Atonement marked the official introduction of the duo's sound to a broader audience. The album was released through Superball Music, a label known for working with artists across alternative and experimental genres. While specific critical reception data is limited in available sources, the project represented a significant undertaking for both members, with the band noting that the creation process involved both creative challenges and triumphs in realizing their collaborative vision.
